Summary of websites posted in 'general':
1) www.informations.com: Latest job report brings mixed relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.
2) www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the city center known for authentic Swiss cuisine (cheese fondue, rösti, chocolate fondue), with warm wooden interiors, panoramic skyline views and staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Dora! I visited your website. It's clean and your contact email is easy to find. It would be even better with more content, such as an intro about you, your projects or work, and some visuals or a clearer layout. Nice start!

Hi Eve! I enjoyed visiting your blog. Hiking is a great topic and it comes across as personal and friendly. To improve it, you could add more posts, such as trail stories, photos and tips, and include a bit more structure like categories or dates. Keep it up!
